shortDescription: Manage volumes on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: app_type
options.description: Application type to indicate the intended use of the volume.

options.name: app_type_other
options.description: Application type for volume when I(app_type) is set to C(*Other) types.

options.name: appliance_id
options.description: ID of the appliance on which the volume is provisioned. I(appliance_id) and I(appliance_name) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: appliance_name
options.description: Name of the appliance on which the volume is provisioned. I(appliance_id) and I(appliance_name) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: backup_snap_profile
options.description: Details of the backup snapshot set to be created.

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: Volume size unit. Used to signify unit of the size provided for creation and expansion of volume. It defaults to C(GB), if not specified.

options.name: clone_volume
options.description: Details of the volume clone.

options.name: create_backup_snap
options.description: Indicates whether a backup snapshot of the target volume will be created or not.

options.name: delete_remote_volume
options.description: Whether to delete the remote volume during removal of metro session. This is parameter is added in the PowerStore version 3.0.0.0.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the volume. Optional parameter when creating a volume. To modify, pass the new value in description field.

options.name: end_metro_config
options.description: Whether to end the metro session from a volume. This is mandatory for end metro configuration operation.

options.name: hlu
options.description: Logical unit number for the host/host group volume access. Optional parameter when mapping a volume to host/host group. HLU modification is not supported.

options.name: host
options.description: Host to be mapped/unmapped to a volume. If not specified, an unmapped volume is created. Only one of the host or host group can be supplied in one call. To represent host, both name or ID can be used interchangeably. The module will detect both.

options.name: hostgroup
options.description: Hostgroup to be mapped/unmapped to a volume. If not specified, an unmapped volume is created. Only one of the host or host group can be mapped in one call. To represent a hostgroup, both name or ID can be used interchangeably. The module will detect both.

options.name: mapping_state
options.description: Define whether the volume should be mapped to a host or hostgroup. Value C(mapped) - indicates that the volume should be mapped to the host or host group. Value C(unmapped) - indicates that the volume should not be mapped to the host or host group. Only one of a host or host group can be supplied in one call.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new volume name for the volume, used in case of rename functionality.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: performance_policy
options.description: The I(performance_policy) for the volume. A volume can be assigned a performance policy at the time of creation of the volume, or later. The policy can also be changed for a given volume, by simply passing the new value. Check examples for more clarity. If not given, performance policy will be C(medium).

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: protection_policy
options.description: The I(protection_policy) of the volume. To represent policy, both name or ID can be used interchangably. The module will detect both. A volume can be assigned a protection policy at the time of creation of the volume or later. The policy can also be changed for a given volume by simply passing the new value. The policy can be removed by passing an empty string. Check examples for more clarity.

options.name: qos_performance_policy
options.description: The QoS performance policy name or ID for the volume. Associates an IO limit rule policy with the volume for bandwidth/IOPS control. Requires PowerStoreOS 4.0 or later. To represent policy, both name or ID can be used interchangeably. The module will detect both. A volume can be assigned a QoS policy at the time of creation or later. The policy can also be changed for a given volume by simply passing the new value. To remove the QoS policy from a volume, pass an empty string C(''). If not specif

options.name: remote_appliance_id
options.description: A remote system appliance ID to which volume will be assigned. This parameter is added in PowerStore version 3.0.0.0.

options.name: remote_system
options.description: The remote system to which metro relationship will be established. The remote system must support metro volume. This is mandatory while configuring a metro volume. To represent remote system, both name and ID are interchangeable. This parameter is added in PowerStore version 3.0.0.0.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of the volume. Minimum volume size is 1MB. Maximum volume size is 256TB. Size must be a multiple of 8192. Required in case of create and expand volume.

options.name: source_snap
options.description: Unique identifier or name of the source snapshot that will be used for the restore operation.

options.name: source_volume
options.description: Unique identifier or name of the volume to refresh from.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the volume should exist or not. Value C(present) - indicates that the volume should exist on the system. Value C(absent) - indicates that the volume should not exist on the system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vg_name
options.description: The name of the volume group. A volume can optionally be assigned to a volume group at the time of creation. Use the Volume Group Module for modification of the assignment.

options.name: vol_id
options.description: The 36 character long ID of the volume, automatically generated when a volume is created. Cannot be used while creating a volume. All other functionalities on a volume are supported using volume name or ID.

options.name: vol_name
options.description: Unique name of the volume. This value must contain 128 or fewer printable unicode characters. Required when creating a volume. All other functionalities on a volume are supported using volume name or ID.
